mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Vi fell to Warwick, leaving deep wounds and deeper doubts.

“Who—what—was that? It couldn't have been…”

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Blood Hunt</titleLeft><mainText>Warwick is hunting. He gains Move Speed toward and attack speed against the nearest enemy champion.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Warwick and his allies gain an altered Denting Blows passive.

Every third Attack or Ability on the same target deals an additional 5% max Health physical damage and shreds 5% Armor and 5% Magic Resist for 3 seconds. This effect has a 5 second Cooldown per target.

“Nightwatch Log: Violent confrontation between undercity scrappers and unknown entity. Multiple casualties. Entity hardly seemed human…” - patrolling enforcer

mLocKeys.keySummary: Warwick gains damage reduction for 2.5 seconds. At the end, or if re-activated, he howls, causing nearby enemies to flee for 1 second.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Warwick gains @Effect1Amount@% damage reduction for 2.5 seconds. After it ends, Warwick howls, <status>Fearing</status> nearby enemies for @Effect3Amount@ second. Warwick can <recast>Recast</recast> to end the Ability early.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Eternal Hunger</titleLeft><mainText>Warwick's basic attacks deal <font color='#FFFFFF'>@f1@</font> bonus magic damage. If Warwick is below 50% health, he heals the same amount. If Warwick is below 25% health, this healing triples.</mainText>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Warwick's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage. If Warwick is below 50% health, he heals the same amount. If Warwick is below 25% health, this healing triples.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Warwick's Attacks deal an additional @OnHitDamage@ magic damage On-Hit.

If Warwick is below @HealingThreshold*100@% Health, he also heals for @HealingRatio*100@% of the damage dealt by Eternal Hunger. If Warwick is below @EmpoweredHealingThreshold*100@% health, the healing is increased to @EmpoweredHealingRatio*100@% of the damage dealt.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Warwick lunges forward and bites his target, dealing damage based on their maximum health and healing for damage dealt.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Tap: Warwick lunges forward and bites, dealing @BaseBiteDamage@ plus @TargetPercentHPDamage@% max Health magic damage and healing for @Effect3Amount@% of the damage dealt.

Hold: Warwick lunges and clamps his jaws on the target, leaping behind them. While clamped, Warwick follows all movement of the target. After releasing his hold, he does the same damage and healing.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
This Ability applies On-Hit and On-Attack effects, and does not Critically Strike.
While clamped, Warwick is immune to displacement.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Warwick leaps in a direction (scaling with his bonus Move Speed), suppressing the first champion he collides with for 1.5 seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Warwick leaps a huge distance that scales with his <speed>Move Speed</speed>, <status>Suppressing</status> the first champion he collides with while he channels for @RDuration@ seconds. He attacks that champion 3 times over the duration, dealing <magicDamage>@DamageCumulative@ magic damage</magicDamage>. Warwick <healing>heals for 100% of all damage dealt</healing> during the channel.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
This Ability applies On-Hit and On-Attack effects 3 distinct times over its duration, and does not Critically Strike.
This Ability Knocks Down enemies.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Blood Hunt</titleLeft><mainText>Warwick is hunting this target. He gains Move Speed toward and attack speed against it.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Warwick senses enemies below 50% health, gaining Move Speed toward and attack speed against them. When they fall below 25% health, he frenzies and these bonuses triple.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Warwick can sense champions below 50% Health, gaining @PassiveMSBonus@% Move Speed towards them. Spells and attacks against enemies below 50% Health grant @PassiveASBonus@% Attack Speed. These effects are increased by 200% against enemies below 25% Health.

Active: Warwick can briefly sense all enemies, and gains this Ability's passive effect against the closest champion for 8 seconds, regardless of Health. If no champions are found, this Ability's cooldown is reduced by 30%.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Warwick can only passively sense enemies who were brought below 50% Health by allies.</rules>
